description:
We are the

Savaksky Union

and you will embrace

Glorious Liberation.

An upbeat Soviet-themed faction with North Korea-like ironic monarchy.
A strong focus in energy weapons and missiles will carry the might of the liberation.
Their ships aesthethics are reflective of the golden age of soviet space aviation mixed with generous dash of sci-fi.
